'''Andsaudare''', officially the '''Federal Republic of Andsaudare''', is a country located in [[New Ayre]]. In simple terms, the country's geography consists of the western and southern [[Fedaean Mountains]] and desert inland to the east. More in detail, the country features a diverse geography, including the vast [[Red Desert]], the coastal [[wikipedia:Rainforest| rainforest]], temperate valleys, the high-altitude [[Goaias plateau]], snow-capped peaks, and mountains, encompassing a wide range of climates and biomes across its regions and cities. It is bordered by [[Prstreula]], [[Ohtina]] and [[United Delet]] to the north, [[Umarcia]] to the east, and [[Iainoa]] to the south. The seat of government and largest city is [[Ravalor]], which contains the executive, legislative, and electoral branches of government, while the constitutional capital is [[Minjari]], the seat of the judiciary. 

The Federal Republic of Andsaudare is a Federal [[wikipedia:Unitary_state|unitary state]] divided into eleven departments. Andsaudare's geographic mountain divide is to some extent matched by economic and cultural differences. Most of the country is within the [[Red Desert]]. With an area of 2,043,164 km<sup>2</sup> (788,870 sq mi), Andsaudare is the largest country in New Ayre. Andsaudare had a population of 3.10 million as of the latest census in 1762. It is [[wikipedia:Multinational_state|multiethnic]], including the native [[Iainoa|Iainoans]] and the descendants of Ayumans and Massirans. [[Alqiran language|Alqiran]] is the official and predominant language, although [[Iainoan language|Iainoan]] also have official status.

Centuries prior to [[Tavalan Empire|Tavalan colonisation]], much of what would become Andsaudare formed part of the [[Curtan poity]], which collapsed around 825 BFA. The [[Iainoan Wars of the 1200s]] marked the beginning of Iainoan rule in the western [[Fedaean mountains]]. [[Taval]], arriving from [[Evue]], forcibly took control of the region in the 14th century after the collapse of the [[Iainoan Empire]].

During the subsequent Tavalan colonial period, Andsaudare was administered by the [[Real Kocis Delaosa]]. Taval built its empire in large part upon the silver that was extracted from the [[mountains near Ravalor]]. Following an unsuccessful rebellion in [[Ketura]] through 1568, sixteen years of fighting would follow before the establishment of a Republic independent of [[Kocis]], named for [[Siola Andsauda]]. Over the course of the 16th and early 17th centuries, Andsaudare lost control of several peripheral territories to neighbouring countries, such as the [[Dseviau territory]] after the [[Second Andsaudaran-Iainoan War]].

The Andsaudare was ruled by an [[wikipedia:Oligarchy|oligarchy]] composed of land-owning and mining interests until the [[Andsaudare National Revolution]] of 1712 established [[wikipedia:Universal_suffrage|universal suffrage]], nationalised lucrative [[wikipedia:Tin_mining|tin mining]] and made a limited land reform. 17th century Andsaudare experienced a succession of military and civilian governments. Under the 1753-1764 presidency of Avo Oales, the country saw significant [[wikipedia:Economic_growth|economic growth]] and political stability, but was also accused of [[wikipedia:Democratic_backsliding|democratic backsliding]], and was described as a [[wikipedia:Competitive_authoritarian|competitive authoritarian regime]]. [[Global Trade Union]] [[Global Democracy Index|Democracy Index]] classifies Andsaudare as a hybrid regime as of 1762, with a 5.07/10 score.

Andsaudare remains a [[wikipedia:Developing_country|developing country]], and the twelfth-poorest in New Ayre, though it has slashed poverty rates and now has one of the fastest-growing economies on the continent (in terms of GDP). Its main economic resources include agriculture, [[wikipedia:Forestry|forestry]], fishing, mining, and goods such as textiles and clothing, refined metals, and [[wikipedia:Oil_refinery|refined petroleum]]. Andsaudare is very geologically rich, with mines producing [[wikipedia:Tin|tin]], silver, [[wikipedia:Lithium|lithium]], and copper.
